rounds.text: Khyati Multimedia Entertainment Ltd presents a significant risk profile when evaluating its long-term performance versus recent snapshots. While the company currently reports a positive return on equity [E13, E28, E53], this stands in stark contrast to a decade of structural underperformance where the median return on equity was -6% [E25], -10% over five years [E26], and -13% over three years [E27]. This historical trend of negative returns is further underscored by the company being explicitly flagged for a low three-year return on equity of -13.4% [E49]. Investors are also denied any immediate cash return, as the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4]. Relying on recent metrics ignores the persistent, long-term inability of the business to generate consistent equity returns for shareholders [E25, E26, E27].

Khyati Multimedia Entertainment Ltd presents a precarious investment profile defined by a long-term history of value destruction that contradicts recent performance metrics. While the company currently reports a positive return on equity [E13, E28, E53], this is starkly contrasted by a decade of failure, evidenced by a median 10-year return on equity of -6% [E25]. This trend of poor capital allocation has intensified in recent years, with median returns on equity of -10% over five years and -13% over three years [E26, E27, E49]. Investors are asked to pay a premium for this volatility, as the stock trades at a price-to-book ratio of 2.53x [E2]. Furthermore, the company offers no dividend yield to compensate shareholders for these historical risks [E4]. Conceded: the company currently maintains an ROE of 15.9% [E13] and trades at a P/E ratio below the sector benchmark [E6].
